jobs.title: E-commerce Analyst
jobs.summary: Track and analyse marketplace and online sales performance, build weekly reports and turn the numbers into clear recommendations for the account teams.
requirements: 1–3 years in digital marketing, e-commerce or analytics
Clear written English; French is a plus

jobs.title: Senior E-commerce Analyst
jobs.summary: Own the performance analysis for retail and marketplace accounts, guide optimisation decisions and support junior analysts.
requirements: 3+ years in e-commerce, retail media or performance marketing
Comfortable presenting to clients and stakeholders

jobs.title: E-commerce / Catalog Manager
jobs.summary: Manage product listings and content across online retailers and marketplaces, keep catalogues accurate and improve how products show up in search.
requirements: Experience managing online catalogues or marketplace listings
